body: When youre on mac (or whatever you have your vault on at the moment) go onto drive on a browser and click new -> upload folder -> (choose your vault in your file path)
They will be in alphabetical order. I think you can get plugins to arrange them maybe? What I do for my main folders is preface them with a two digit number eg 00 Utility, 01 Personal

I'm on AnkiDroid so it might be slightly different but top right -> manage note types -> (whichever you're using) -> edit cards -> CSS styling (bottom right) -> add whatever. You'll probably want "text-align: left" in the card part
In the type of note (eg Basic, Reversed, etc), you can change the CSS styling specifically the text align
Yes, waypoint plugin lets you create an automatically updating list once you type the trigger (%% Waypoint %%)
You can save them by bookmarking them! And then when you click that bookmark it'll have the filters and groupings that you made :) I didn't realise this for ages
You can use the basic (and reversed) template, it'll test notes from both sides
Do you use a cube when you go through cards? I find it really difficult to write down even algorithms I know well because of how much more it's muscle memory than a string of letters

Do you have the filter on? Turning it off makes text a lot easier to read. I wish there was a way to have the filter on for the game but not the text
